messages:
Ravi: flagging a dark-mode pass I did this morning. noticed a couple of accessibility edge cases on the metrics dashboard heatmap + mini sparklines on 2x/3x scaling. can folks eyeball?

Lina: linking your branch?

Ravi: repo://console/theme/dark-contrast-pass — main swaps are: background -> #0F1214, panel -> #15181A, accent -> #2EC4B6, spotlight -> #FFE28A. also tightened chart stroke widths to 1.25px for high-res screens.

Marco: quick scan  the accent is nice but the spotlight yellow (#FFE28A) is very bright on top of panel borders. feels like it's floating. maybe lower saturation to #F0D88A or add 10% opacity overlay?

Zoe: agree with Marco. Also the heatmap top bucket is too similar to its neighbor when viewed at small scale. I ran the colorblind simulator (deuteranopia) and the top two buckets collapse.

DesignBot: automated a11y check finished: 
- overall contrast (text on panel): 5.1:1 PASS
- small UI text (11px) on accent background: 3.2:1 FAIL
- heatmap adjacent bucket delta (normal vision): 6.4 delta PASS
- heatmap adjacent bucket delta (deuteranopia): 1.1 delta FAIL (top two buckets indistinguishable)

Ravi: good catch. for heatmap I'm proposing changing the sequential to a diverging-ish ramp so extremes are more separable. new stops: #06292D, #0B3F44, #1B7A8F, #56C9D2, #0A4B60 (adds darker anchor).

Marco: prefer the darker anchor. Also can we add a thin outline to heatmap cells on hover only? default outline makes the whole map look grid-like. hover outline at 1px with rgba(255,255,255,0.06) should be enough.

Lina: about small UI text on accent (3.2:1)  we either need to darken accent or lighten the text when used in-chip. Since accent is a brand color, suggest chip text becomes white with 0.95 opacity on dark chips and accent remains at --accent. That keeps brand visible but fixes contrast.

Ravi: implemented a quick variant: chip text white, chip border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08), accent left as #2EC4B6. Pushed commit and screenshots.

Zoe: screenshots look better. For sparklines on retina displays, lines at 1px can look thin. Can we double-pixel them with stroke 2px but use stroke-alignment: center; or draw via canvas at devicePixelRatio?

Marco: we already draw sparklines with canvas, update to multiply line width by DPR to keep visual weight consistent. small perf cost but still fine for mini sparklines.

DesignBot: visual regression run: 
- chart snapshots: 2 diffs (heatmap top bucket, caret visibility in code snippet)
- suggest caret color #FFFFFFDE for inline editor in dark mode

Ravi: caret fix pushed. For the heatmap I updated the gradient and added the darker end stop (#052E3A) at the top. Also added focused cell outline only during keyboard navigation (outline-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12)).

Lina: one more accessibility nit: focus rings on metric tiles are currently 2px solid accent which has low contrast against panel when in dark mode. Could we switch to a 3px overlay with semi-transparent white (rgba(255,255,255,0.14)) for higher visibility?

Ravi: sounds reasonable. I'll make the focus ring a two-layer style: outer 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) plus inner 1px accent border. keeps brand while improving visibility.

Marco: also logged a small issue about legend text size  when the panel is at 320px narrow, legend wraps and the tokens overlap the values. Propose truncating labels and showing full text on hover tooltip.

Zoe: agree. tooltips should be accessible via keyboard too. add aria-describedby to legend items.

Ravi: ok action items: 
- Ravi: update heatmap gradient + hover outlines + caret color (done)
- Marco: implement DPR-aware sparklines (in progress)
- Lina: finalize chip text treatment and update design tokens doc
- Zoe: keyboard tooltip accessibility audit

DesignBot: follow-up checks queued: colorblind simulation, contrast re-check on mobile widths, focus order sanitizer.

Ravi: thanks y'all. I'll wait for the DPR patch and then merge once CI + snapshots green. :thumbsup:
